name: S3Future - Sustainable Living Experience
summary:
# Experience Sustainable Living in VR

S3 Future VR is an immersive virtual reality experience where users can explore a peaceful sustainable eco-community designed around nature, self-sufficiency, and future living.

Walk through eco-friendly homes, farming areas, ponds, livestock spaces, and community gathering zones while experiencing a connected and environmentally conscious lifestyle.

Explore the world using multiple interactive modes:

- 🚶 Walk Mode
- 🚗 Drive Mode
- 🚁 Helicopter View
- 🕊 Fly Mode
